title: 激光器风琴罩着火
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/02_Burning Laser Bellows Jan2020.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/02_Burning Laser Bellows Jan2020/src.py

points.K4: 积灰既是隐患也是燃料

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台激光切割机旁，指着机头上方的波纹管
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a laser cutting machine and points at the folded bellows tube above the cutting head.
shots.narration: 今天看一段风琴管着火的现场。

shots.scene: 风琴管、火苗、积灰三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a folded bellows tube, a small flame and a pile of dark soot. No people.
shots.narration: 看清它在哪、怎么烧、为什么危险。

shots.scene: 老李走到一台激光切割机前，抬头看机头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks up to a laser cutting machine and looks up at the cutting head.
shots.narration: 老李来检查一台激光切割机。

shots.scene: 机头上方的波纹护套上透出一点橙红色火光
shots.prompt_en: An orange glow shows through a hole in the folded bellows tube above the cutting head. No people.
shots.narration: 机头上方的风琴管里透出火光。

shots.scene: 老李举起空白手机，对着火光竖拍
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds up a blank phone vertically and films the glowing spot.
shots.narration: 老李举起手机，把这一幕拍了下来。

shots.scene: 示意图：切割头上方一根可伸缩的波纹管包着光路
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram: a folding bellows tube above a laser cutting head encloses the beam path. No people.
shots.narration: 切割头上方的光路由风琴管包着。

shots.scene: 切割头上下移动，风琴管随之伸长缩短
shots.prompt_en: Animation: the cutting head moves up and down and the bellows tube stretches and compresses with it. No people.
shots.narration: 它能伸缩，跟着切割头上下移动。

shots.scene: 风琴管外灰尘飞舞，管内的光路干干净净
shots.prompt_en: Dust floats outside the bellows tube while the beam path inside stays clean. No people.
shots.narration: 作用是挡住粉尘，保护光路。

shots.scene: 欣欣比划一个伸缩的动作
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot mimes stretching and squeezing an accordion.
shots.narration: 名字就来自它像手风琴的褶皱。

shots.scene: 风琴管侧面褶皱上一个烧开的小洞，洞里橙红色火光
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a black folded bellows tube with a burned hole on one side, an orange glow inside. No people.
shots.narration: 这根风琴管的侧面被烧穿了。

shots.scene: 洞下方还有一个亮黄色的小火点
shots.prompt_en: A small bright yellow spot of fire just below the burned hole on the bellows. No people.
shots.narration: 洞里有火光，下面还有一个亮点。

shots.scene: 火光在褶皱间忽明忽暗，洞口边缘发黑
shots.prompt_en: The orange glow flickers between the folds and the edges of the hole are blackened. No people.
shots.narration: 火光忽明忽暗，洞口边缘发黑。

shots.scene: 护套材料慢慢变红变黑的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram: the bellows material slowly glows red and chars black without open flames. No people.
shots.narration: 说明护套材料正在阴燃。

shots.scene: 镜头拉远：风琴管下面是方形机座、切割头
shots.prompt_en: Wider view: below the bellows tube are a square mount and the laser cutting head. No people.
shots.narration: 镜头拉远，下面就是切割头。

shots.scene: 多根黑色气管和细电缆用白色扎带捆在机头旁
shots.prompt_en: Several black gas hoses and thin cables bundled with white cable ties beside the cutting head. No people.
shots.narration: 旁边是捆在一起的气管和电缆。

shots.scene: 示意图：火点外圈扩大，覆盖管线和机头
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a red circle around the burning spot grows larger until it covers the hoses, cables and the cutting head. No people.
shots.narration: 火势一扩大，管线和机头都会被波及。

shots.section_title: 积灰既是隐患也是燃料
shots.scene: 风琴管旁的导轨和机架上积满黑色烟灰
shots.prompt_en: Thick black soot and debris cover the rails and frame next to the bellows tube. No people.
shots.narration: 风琴管周围积满了黑色烟灰。
overlay: 积灰既是隐患也是燃料

shots.section_title: 积灰既是隐患也是燃料
shots.scene: 齿条和导轨上的黑色絮状积灰特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of fluffy black soot built up on a toothed rack and guide rail. No people.
shots.narration: 齿条、导轨上也全是碎屑。

shots.section_title: 积灰既是隐患也是燃料
shots.scene: 积灰图标加上火苗图标，箭头指向更大的火
shots.prompt_en: An icon of soot plus an icon of a flame, with an arrow pointing to a bigger flame. No people.
shots.narration: 长期没清洁，积灰还是可燃物。

shots.scene: 远景中风琴管上部仍有一个暗红色的点
shots.prompt_en: A wide view of the machine head: a dark red glowing spot remains on the upper part of the bellows. No people.
shots.narration: 拉远以后，燃烧点还在发红。

shots.scene: 一旁红色数码显示仪表亮着，管线缠在下方
shots.prompt_en: A red digital display meter glows in the corner, with tangled hoses below. No people.
shots.narration: 机器旁的仪表还亮着。

shots.scene: 沙漏旁一个始终发红的小火点
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass next to a small glowing red spot that keeps glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 阴燃不会自己熄灭，要及时发现处理。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现风琴管、烧洞、管线、积灰四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four icons: a bellows tube, a burned hole, bundled hoses and soot.
shots.narration: 风琴管护光路，也会被烧穿阴燃。

shots.scene: 老李看着机头上积灰的导轨，若有所思
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer looks thoughtfully at the soot-covered rails on the machine head.
shots.narration: 火点挨着管线，积灰是燃料，要早发现。

shots.scene: 欣欣在切割机旁挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the laser cutting machine.
shots.narration: 风琴管的故事就到这里，下次见！
